bonus.title: Claim a Feedback Bonus
bonus.privacy: RateLoop checks this review on your device, sending only its public round and vote key. The paid commit’s public tlock ciphertext becomes decryptable after the commit deadline with no post-commit abort, exposing the vote, prediction, response hash, payout address, and salt even without a reveal or claim. Claiming later submits the payout address and salt on-chain; any wallet may relay, but funds still go to that address.
bonus.connectDescription: Connect a wallet to claim. Funds go only to the saved payout address.

settlement.description: Open a saved review locally, reveal it if automatic disclosure has not completed, and claim before the deadline. RateLoop receives only the public round and vote key. Your recovery secret, payout key, salt, vote, and response stay in this browser until you approve the exact on-chain transaction.

eligibility.invitedIntro: Use a paid-enabled workspace invitation. The workspace attests adulthood; RateLoop does not verify age with documents or biometrics.
